lines.beaver: 어젯밤에 잠꼬대를 엄청 하더라. 잘 못 잤니?
lines.beaver_en: You talked in your sleep a lot last night. Didn't you sleep well?
lines.beaver_roman: eojetbame jamkkodaereul eomcheong hadeora. jal mot janni?
lines.en: Yes, I tossed and turned all night and slept badly.

lines.beaver: 요즘 매일 그러잖아. 낮에도 꾸벅꾸벅 졸던데.
lines.beaver_en: You've been like that every day lately. You doze off during the day, too.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum maeil geureojana. najedo kkubeokkkubeok joldeonde.
lines.en: That's right. I even nodded off during a meeting.

lines.beaver_en: What time do you usually go to bed these days?
lines.learner: 일이 늦게 끝나서 새벽 두 시에 자요.
lines.en: Work ends late, so I go to bed at 2 a.m.
lines.roman: iri neutge kkeunnaseo saebyeok du sie jayo.

lines.beaver: 너무 늦다. 자기 전에 휴대폰도 보지?
lines.beaver_en: That's too late. You look at your phone before bed, too, right?
lines.beaver_roman: neomu neutda. jagi jeone hyudaepondo boji?
lines.en: Yes, I habitually watch videos in bed.

lines.beaver: 그러니 푹 못 자지. 일을 좀 줄여 봐.
lines.beaver_en: No wonder you can't sleep well. Try cutting back on work.
lines.beaver_roman: geureoni puk mot jaji. ireul jom juryeo bwa.
lines.en: Even if I cut back work, it's no use if I keep using my phone.

lines.beaver: 일리 있는 말이네. 그럼 어떻게 할 거야?
lines.beaver_en: That makes sense. So what will you do?
lines.beaver_roman: illi inneun marine. geureom eotteoke hal geoya?
lines.learner: 열한 시에 양치하고 바로 눕기로 했어요.
lines.en: I decided to brush my teeth at 11 and lie down right away.
lines.roman: yeolhan sie yangchihago baro nupgiro haesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋다. 그걸 꾸준히 지키는 게 중요해.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Sticking to it consistently is what matters.
lines.beaver_roman: jota. geugeol kkujunhi jikineun ge jungyohae.
lines.learner: 네, 잠이 안 와도 휴대폰은 거실에 둘게요.
lines.en: Yes, even if I can't sleep, I'll leave my phone in the living room.
lines.roman: ne, jami an wado hyudaeponeun geosire dulgeyo.

lines.beaver: 베개는 괜찮아? 너무 높으면 목이 아파.
lines.beaver_en: Is your pillow okay? If it's too high, your neck will hurt.
lines.beaver_roman: begaeneun gwaenchana? neomu nopeumyeon mogi apa.
lines.learner: 높은 베개를 베서 그런지 목이 뻐근해요.
lines.en: Maybe because I use a high pillow, my neck feels stiff.
lines.roman: nopeun begaereul beseo geureonji mogi ppeogeunhaeyo.

lines.beaver: 내일 낮은 베개로 하나 사 줄게.
lines.beaver_en: I'll buy you a lower pillow tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: naeil najeun begaero hana sa julge.
lines.en: Thank you. Sleep is as important as food, clothing and shelter.

lines.beaver: 그럼. 오늘부터 일찍 자고 푹 쉬어.
lines.beaver_en: Of course. Starting today, go to bed early and rest well.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom. oneulbuteo iljjik jago puk swieo.
lines.learner: 네, 오늘부터 꼭 일찍 잘게요. 안녕히 주무세요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll be sure to go to bed early from today. Good night.
lines.roman: ne, oneulbuteo kkok iljjik jalgeyo. annyeonghi jumuseyo.
